thread:
nina: Kicking off a quick thread from the monthly access review. Found a cluster of admin-role escalations caused by a recent infra IAM template change. Some service accounts now have roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter and roles/owner in staging->prod flip.

hakim: oh no. which template change? link?

nina: PR: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/commit/3f2c9. The change was intended to consolidate CI runners but accidentally copied a prod role map into staging path. CSV exported: https://drive.internal/redwood/audit/4119990001_flip.csv (svcacct,last_used,roles,iam_path).

jyoti: are any of those svcaccts cross-project or external? that raises KMS grant concerns.

ben: quick scan: 4 svcaccts with owner-like roles; 2 have KMS grants that map to prod keyrings. If these principals are unclaimed we can't revoke until we do a key-handshake.

audit-bot: [audit] Change 3f2c9 introduced 14 binding diffs across envs. Recommended: revert misapplied template in staging and run least-priv dry-run. Evidence snapshot stored: drive link.

nina: plan proposal: 1) revert template in infra prune PR 2) create SecTracker tickets for the 6 high-priv principals 3) for KMS-bound principals run a canary rotation 4) attach audit snapshot to each ticket 5) schedule a 48h monitor window.

hakim: for KMS-handshake: provision temp key (key-temp-4119990001), update a canary subset of callers (5%) via CI env override, watch decrypt errors. I can script the rollout.

jyoti: add log filter for "PermissionDenied" and a short-lived sink -> saves traces for incident triage. Also include a KMS rotation checklist in the ticket.

security-bot: policy reminder: any role change that escalates a principal to Owner must be accompanied by two-person review and an attached justification. External principals are disallowed for Owner.

ben: also found one artifact: a terraform state snapshot referenced an fqdn with an old key id in a public gist (not public leak but risky). opened a vuln-ticket: SecTracker#9987.

nina: seceng triage: we need short-term mitigation and long-term process fix. Mitigation: revert template and remove owner bindings; perform key-handshake for KMS-bound svcaccts; patch terraform state to remove key id; audit alerting. Long-term: add CI lint rule to reject env mixing of prod role maps.

hakim: for the terraform state leak: rotate the referenced key, rotate callers, mark vuln as high until rotated. I can own rotation if jyoti or ben pair.

jyoti: pairing ok. we'll script rotation -> update callers -> smoke-test -> snapshot logs. Add monitor: if >3 failed decrypts in 5m page eng-oncall. oncall-bot, create monitor?

oncall-bot: created monitor "kms-snowball-4119990001": threshold 3 failed decrypts / 5m -> page eng-oncall sev2.

ben: timeline: revert PR now, create tickets today, key rotations during maintenance window tonight 01:00-02:00 UTC, 48h monitor. Evidence to attach: last_used, PRs touching iam_path, terraform state commit, and dry-run outputs.

nina: will create tickets with fields: svcacct, roles_before, roles_after, evidence_links, kms_handshake_required(yes/no), owner_claim_by(EOD+3). If unclaimed, we follow revoke-with-handshake procedure.

security-bot: note: emergency revokes on principals with persistent KMS grants require SecEng lead + Compliance approval. Use emergency-revoke only after approvals.

hakim: will post runbook and the rotation script in the ticket. Ben/jyoti please sign off after smoke-tests.

ben: on it. starting revert PR now -> https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pull/5012 (WIP).

nina: thanks. if anyone sees additional outbound grants in the dry-run, flag with label "break-risk". I'll update thread with ticket numbers. :white_check_mark:
